messages.subject: adding color to thin plate spline
parts:
Hello all,
I am trying to add color to groups on a thin plate spline. I am receiving the error code

 Error in legend(0.5, 1, legend = unique(groups), pch = 19, bty = "n",  : 
  'legend' is of length 0

and no color appears in the graph. I believe it is an issue with how I am assigning the groups because gp appears as a factor with zero levels in the environment but i am unsure why.
my code is below and I have attached an example data set, can anyone point out where I have gone wrong? 


library(geomorph)

Y <- arrayspecs(Classifiertable75, k=2, p= ncol(Classifiertable75)/2)

Y.gpa <- gpagen(Y,curves=NULL)

summary(Y.gpa)

plot(Y.gpa)


Y.gpa <- gpagen(Y,curves=NULL,ProcD=TRUE)   

summary(Y.gpa)

plot(Y.gpa)

a<-(Y.gpa$coords)

gp<-interaction(factor(Classifiertable75$Rafalt,Classifiertable75$Rafnas,Classifiertable75$Rafpon))

plotTangentSpace(a,label=TRUE,groups=gp, legend =TRUE)

write.table(a, "Procrustesadjusted75")





Thank you in advance.
-Ian

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] adding color to thin plate spline
parts:
Ian,

 

The line in your code where you try to create a group does not make sense relative to the datafile you provided. Thus, the ‘gp’ variable is null, which is causing the error. It is not a geomorph issue, but an R-related data manipulation issue. You need to tell R what groups might be to be able to do such things.

 

For instance, if I make up groups but use proper R-notation such as:

 

gp<-as.factor(c(rep(1,30),rep(2,45)))

 

Providing this through the plotTangentSpace code you sent does in fact color code by group.

 

Dean
